description: Analyses an investment portfolio from its transaction history: net invested capital, current value, absolute return, chain-linked time-weighted return (TWR), CAGR on initial invested capital, per-sub-portfolio breakdown and allocation shares, with multi-currency support via per-transaction FX rates. Use to analyze actual portfolio ledgers or current holdings and valuation data. Require real transactions/holdings and a current valuation for each holding; require FX rates where currencies differ. TWR needs a valuation immediately before each later external cash flow and at the end date; report null with its reason when absent. Equal and opposite same-day movements between sleeves in the base currency net to an internal transfer for combined TWR; confirm both legs before using that treatment. Missing acquisition cost may use the disclosed performance-from-today behavior. Never create transactions or holdings records.

asOfDate.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) used as the CAGR end date. Defaults to today.

baseCurrency.description: Reporting currency (e.g. EUR). Transactions in another currency require fxRate.

subPortfolios.description: One entry per account, broker or strategy sleeve.

cashBalance.description: Uninvested cash swept into a holdings sleeve's value (counts 1:1 on invested and current value).

cashLabel.description: Cash bucket label (e.g. emergency, savings, collateral, current).

currency.description: Currency the transactions are denominated in.

holdings.description: Positions for a holdings sleeve. Omitted avgCostPrice tracks returns from today (day-1 return 0%).

transactions.description: Ledger for cash_flow sleeves. May be empty for holdings sleeves (valued from holdings closes).

amount.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

fxRate.description: Units of sub-portfolio currency per one unit of base currency. Required when currencies differ.

type.description: Deposit/Withdrawal are cash flows; Value is a portfolio valuation snapshot.
cash_flow: transaction ledger sleeve. holdings: EOD snapshot sleeve valued from holdings closes (transactions may be empty).

name: analyze_portfolio
